notes: Performance window on the Tech log page, with a Takeoff and a Landing tab. Both use Fenix's own calculators, so the figures are the ones its tablet gives.
Takeoff shows V1, VR, V2, flex or TOGA, flap, trim, the weight limit and the stop margin, with a runway drawing. Send to MCDU puts them on the PERF page.
Fixed: a part with 11% of its life left showed a full bar, which was the time left to carry the item. Both bars are now labelled, and a part item shows its own life.
Fixed: a well maintained aircraft had a worn-out cabin, because seat items ignored the maintenance profile.
